# firstboot_dns_zone (Resource)

A DNS zone hosted on the platform's nameservers.

Creating a zone does NOT prove you own the domain, and it does not make the world ask us about it: point the domain's nameservers at the values in `nameservers` for anything here to be answered.

**Destroying a zone destroys its records with it.** The zone name is also global: a name in use elsewhere on the platform is refused.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The zone's apex, e.g. `example.com`. No update exists, so a change replaces it.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Optional project to group the zone under. Changing it moves the zone in place; it is not a replacement.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on this zone, used to select it from a `firstboot_*` data source and to filter it in the panel.

At most 10, each up to 32 characters of `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `:` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit. `env:prod` is a convention, not a schema: a tag is one flat string.

**Written exactly as given.** The API stores tags lowercased, so a tag that is not already lowercase is refused at plan time rather than silently rewritten — a rewritten value would differ from the configuration on every subsequent plan.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The nameservers to delegate the domain to at its registrar.
